BEFORE YOU START

Ready when the checks agree.

Read-only checks. No test orders are placed.

Connect your paper account, then run a readiness check.

What a passing check means

Broker access, market data, available funds, and broker state have been checked. Existing holdings and pending orders are informational and do not require a flat account. Order fills and stop protection still need observation during a paper session. The engine can wait for the next broker market open.

Trading preferences

Enabled strategies

Tick all strategies you want evaluated. One engine shares your position and risk limits.

News trades run during the regular session using Alpaca news; no AI API key is needed. Shorts require broker permission and easy-to-borrow whole shares.

The position size multiplier increases each strategy’s normal allocation, capped by available capacity and maximum order value. Ten times the size means roughly ten times the profit or loss for the same price move. Exit logic stays unchanged. Swing trades remain subject to overnight margin limits. Slot allocation divides current usable buying power across remaining position slots, capped by maximum order value. It uses margin, with a buffer and a gross exposure ceiling. Swing orders also require overnight buying power; the broker can reject orders for additional margin requirements. Percentage mode uses the percentage field instead. The risk baseline is fixed when configured; it is not your live balance and does not size trades. The equity halt remains a fixed account floor. More positions still require valid signals.

Stop the engine before changing settings.

Prototype research: up to 3 candidates, 2 searches per company, 6 searches per day and a 7-day research cache. The $0.20 daily budget includes searches. Requests reserve estimated costs; a large search response may exceed the estimate, after which further calls stop. Haiku 4.5 is the low-cost default. No AI calls for scalping. Daily reviews are advisory, not automatic sell orders.

Optional AI research API

DISABLED

Add your own Anthropic (Claude) API key if you want AI-assisted research. The trading bot can run without it. AI stays disabled when no key is saved.

Model-specific input/output rates apply within your daily AI budget. No key saved. Your key is encrypted and never displayed again.

Saving a key does not verify it or make a paid request. Enabling AI allows scheduled and signal-driven requests within your daily budget. Fundamentals and earnings evidence still need to be configured.

RESEARCH, THEN EXECUTION

Evidence before action.

Scheduled screening and advisory AI analysis. Your strategy and risk controls decide whether an order can proceed.

—Checking configuration
—Reserved requests count toward the limit

Daily research schedule · Malta

Loading today’s exchange schedule…

Prototype schedule: 08:30 New York screens stocks locally, compares the full technical candidate pool in one AI prompt, then researches up to three AI-selected candidates with at most two searches each and ranks the evidence-complete results. Company research is cached for seven days unless news, earnings or a 5% price move require a refresh. From 10:00: swing entries use the approved watchlist and deterministic checks without another AI call. After close + 15 minutes: one review of up to three non-scalping holdings. Holidays, early closes, and daylight saving follow the exchange calendar.

AI cannot place an order or weaken a stop.

Research failures block new AI-dependent entries. Exits and emergency controls keep working. Web research must supply valid sourced fundamentals and earnings dates before swing entries qualify. Missing evidence blocks those entries; scalping uses its own deterministic rules.
